Level 4 - Advanced 25 min LLD Rubric Rejection post-mortems

Common LLD Mistakes & What Evaluators Check

The grading sheet behind LLD and machine-coding rounds, rebuilt from official company pages, published problem briefs and the rejection posts candidates wrote about themselves. After this page you know what gets checked first, the twelve mistakes that sink most rounds, and a two-minute check to run before you say "done".
